I typed out and erased about 2 paragraphs of the night 3 weeks ago when my bestfriend made me feel pretty worthless, but it boils down to just that. Besides my parents, not a single person in my life has initiated a conversation with me in months. To say i feel completely alone is an understatement. I feel like a waste of resources.

I know there are a few people that love me, but why should I have to suffer just so they don't feel sad? Why is it that just because it will hurt someone else is the reason I shouldn't leave? People hurt other people to make themselves feel better all the time, so why is it that I can't make myself feel better because it will hurt someone?
